children.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: Recent findings identify algebraic conditions for identifying irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks within stoichiometric matrices and demonstrate programmable, history-dependent chemical responses in flow-controlled reaction systems.
detail.reason: Incorporating new stoichiometric network analysis and experimental flow-reactor evidence to advance the project on autocatalytic chemical memory.

children.title: Stoichiometric and Thermodynamic Constraints in Non-Equilibrium Chemical Persistence

detail.title: Stoichiometric and Thermodynamic Constraints in Non-Equilibrium Chemical Persistence
detail.summary: Revised analysis confirms that irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks, characterized by algebraic conditions on stoichiometric submatrices, provide the necessary structure for chemical systems to maintain history-dependent states, distinguishing them from simple hysteresis.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to integrate new stoichiometric findings and differentiate memory mechanisms.
